# Mallside permissions at a glance

**Free to play. Publicly readable source. Commercial redistribution requires the owner's written permission.**

Official game: https://youknowjp.github.io/Mallside/  
Official repository: https://github.com/YouKnowJP/Mallside  
Copyright (c) 2026 Jackson Pham (YouKnowJP), for owned, copyrightable Mallside material.

This guide summarizes the Mallside Proprietary License 1.1. The full LICENSE controls; mandatory legal exceptions, prior valid grants and independent third-party licenses remain effective.

| Activity | Permission |
| --- | --- |
| Play the official game | Welcome, free for personal non-commercial enjoyment. No account or payment required. |
| Share the official play link | Welcome. This is the best way to help others enjoy Mallside. |
| Inspect/download source or modify a local copy privately | Allowed for private non-commercial evaluation, keeping notices. |
| View or fork on GitHub | Subject to GitHub's platform terms; this is not a separate commercial game license. |
| Share non-commercial screenshots, gameplay clips, reviews or tutorials | Allowed for owned Mallside material; identify the game and link to official play where reasonably practicable. Separate third-party rights still apply. |
| Reupload, mirror, host or distribute a playable copy, even free | Separate written permission required, subject to GitHub's applicable platform rights. |
| Sell, rebrand, port or monetize a copy or derivative | Separate written permission required, including ads, subscriptions, sponsorship, paid access, in-game payments or donations tied to the copy. Credit or a new name is not permission. |
| Reuse Three.js or CC0 character assets independently | Follow their own licenses. Mallside does not claim exclusive rights to them. |
| Reuse brand photographs or product artwork | Mallside does not grant those owners' rights. Attribution is not permission. |

For permission, open an issue at https://github.com/YouKnowJP/Mallside/issues describing the intended use. Do not include private contracts or personal information. An inquiry, unanswered request or unreviewed PR is not authorization; obtain explicit written permission from Jackson Pham / YouKnowJP.

The owner distributes the official game free of charge. A seller's paid download, rehost or modified copy is not authorized merely because the source is public. Check the official links above before paying for anything represented as Mallside.

Public browser games cannot be made technically impossible to copy. These terms state permissions for protected material; they are not DRM or a guarantee of enforcement. For details about ownership, human authorship, prior licensing and asset clearance, see docs/RIGHTS.md in the official repository. No copyright or trademark registration is claimed by this guide.
